[P2] Reserve failed-child publication too

Failure serialization still occurs before deciding whether the parent will retain a child checkpoint. A FLAT child failure therefore publishes an unreferenced filesystem file, while early-completion map/parallel operations can submit a late FAIL after the parent stops accepting checkpoints. Route failure serialization and checkpointing through `withChildCheckpointReservation`; when rejected or virtual, retain the failure without persistence stages, and add a blocking failure-stage race test.
